brief: Trial NCT02522598 (Vivozon, phase 2). What is its status and stated reason, and were results ever posted?

findings.claim: Trial NCT02522598 has no stated why_stopped text (overall status is COMPLETED, not stopped).
Results were never posted on ClinicalTrials.gov for trial NCT02522598.
findings.notes: Results due date was January 31, 2017 and it is overdue.

findings.claim: Trial NCT02522598 start date is August 2015, primary completion date is February 2016, completion date is February 2016, and enrollment is 38.
No FDA approval was found for VVZ-149 or Vivozon in Drugs@FDA.
findings.notes: Searched by drug name and sponsor name.

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT02522598'
